description: Linux-native Tavden field system proof of concept for CardputerZero

store.summary: Local system and network visibility for field work
store.description: A keyboard-first Tavden proof of concept for CardputerZero. It presents system health, storage, memory, load and local interface state in a restrained 320x170 interface. Collection is local and read-only: the network module sends no packets and changes no configuration.
